subject: Finlytics POC - success criteria & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@finlytics.com>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@finlytics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Finlytics POC - success criteria & next steps

Thanks again for taking the time earlier, Daniel — great to meet the Finlytics team. Quick recap from today's discovery and proposed next steps for the POC (please confirm / edit):

Key objectives / success criteria
- Integration: Run 10K sample requests from Finlytics anonymized dataset with <10% regression on current inference latency (baseline provided by Finlytics).
- Quality: Match or exceed current model accuracy on the anomaly-detection prompt set (target: >= 92% precision on top-3 suggestions).
- Cost/Throughput: Validate sustained throughput of 50 reqs/s on dedicated small pod while keeping per-token costs within the expected range.

Evaluation plan & ownership
- Finlytics: Provide anonymized sample dataset (S3 link) and a set of evaluation prompts + target outputs (owner: Daniel).
- Redwood: Stand up dedicated POC environment, load model, run evaluation harness, and provide weekly reports (owner: Marcus).
- Success signoff: Joint review at end of 2-week POC (owner: Marissa / Daniel).

Timeline
- Week 0 (this week): Access & infra prep, data handoff, baseline measurements.
- Week 1: Run evaluation, iterate on prompt templates, collect metrics.
- Week 2: Final analysis and executive summary + decision.

Open questions / blockers
- Daniel: Can you confirm when the anonymized S3 export will be available and if there are any additional compliance requirements (IP allowlist / credentials)?
- Sarah: Any internal ops contact we should loop in for network/egress setup?
- Attachments: redwood-poc-mop.xlsx (POC plan & checklist)

Thanks — I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff once we have access.
—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. That all looks good to us. A few clarifications: 

1) Data availability: We have an anonymized export scheduled for Friday (2026-06-19). I’ll share a temporary S3 link and credentials with Marcus and Marcus, and cc'ing our ops alias.
2) Compliance: We need IP allowlist for the S3 access and a short Data Processing Addendum signed — I’ll loop procurement if needed.
3) Owners: Ops contact is ops@finlytics.com (cc’d). For technical validation, Sarah will lead and I’ll be the executive sponsor.

We’re aligned on the 2-week cadence — can you confirm the kickoff slot? Prefer morning PST on Monday (2026-06-22).

Thanks,
Daniel

Great — thanks Daniel. I’ve added access-instructions.pdf to the shared drive and prepared the initial runbook in redwood-poc-mop.xlsx (attached).

Notes for the team:
- For S3 access we prefer a time-limited IAM role with STS (we can also support pre-signed URLs if IP allowlisting is required).
- If you have PII, please confirm the export has been tokenized — we’ll only work with anonymized data.
- I’ll provision a small dedicated pod (4 vGPU equivalent) for the POC and drop the connection details into the Drive folder by EOD Monday.

Proposed kickoff: Mon 2026-06-22 09:30 PT — I’ll include a short agenda: intro, data handoff, infra checklist, evaluation harness runbook.

Hi team — weekly touchpoint and quick nudge to keep the POC moving. Status summary: 

Completed
- Kickoff held (Mon 6/22): infra provisioned, sample file uploaded.
- Redwood: initial baseline run completed against sample_anon.csv — preliminary latency within expected range.

In progress
- Marcus: evaluation harness running across full sample export (ETA Tue 6/29).
- Daniel/Sarah: procurement reviewing DPA and confirm IP allowlist windows (ETA Mon 6/28).

Blockers / asks (please action this week)
- Daniel: Share final S3 link with STS role or presigned URL (we need access to run full eval).
- Sarah: Confirm whether Finlytics will pre-mask account IDs or if Redwood should apply record-level masking during ingestion — if you prefer Redwood to mask, we need a short spec by Fri 6/26.
- Naomi: I’ve asked product to enable longer eval logs retention for this POC — Naomi will follow up on retention policy.

Next sync: Quick 20-min check on Wed 6/30 at 10:00 PT to review interim metrics and any config changes. If anything moves sooner, reply-all with updates.

Attachments: access-instructions.pdf (network & S3 setup steps)

Thanks everyone — looking forward to progress.
